name: Dataset lineage v1 — consolidated source inventory
notes: Earlier combined inventory: Aircraft Damage Yaked V4 (3,715), UTS V3 (6,803), Zenodo Dataset C (856). Earlier readiness notes flagged unresolved taxonomy, Zenodo annotation availability and split-independence checks. Not interchangeable with the later v5 benchmark.

name: Dataset lineage v2 — E7 six-class YOLO bundle
notes: Bundle inventory: 8,446 train, 1,335 validation, 728 test. Training cache recorded 16,035 training objects. This is a distinct split inventory; do not assume identical records or split membership with v1.

name: Dataset v5 — locked research evaluation baseline
notes: Current audited baseline. 20,471 valid annotations; no malformed labels, invalid class IDs/coordinates, zero-area boxes, exact duplicates or missing/empty annotation images. 306 cross-split near-duplicate candidates remain unconfirmed; aircraft/session independence is not established.

findings: Locked test fingerprint matches the current test images.
No exact SHA-256 image duplicates were detected across splits.
No malformed, invalid-class, invalid-coordinate or zero-area annotations were detected.
22.6% of valid annotations fall below 0.1% image area.
risks: 306 perceptual near-duplicate candidates cross split boundaries; manually inspect them.
No obvious aircraft/inspection metadata files were discovered by filename/content keyword scan.
recommendations: Folder names repeat between splits. Determine whether these are meaningful aircraft/session identifiers.
Do not modify the locked v5 test split before completing the audit and preserving the current baseline.
If aircraft/session IDs exist, create a separate group-held-out evaluation split rather than randomly repartitioning images.
If group IDs do not exist, perform exact and near-duplicate review and document that aircraft-independent generalization cannot be verified.
For the next training ablation, preserve the current split and compare standard sampling against scale-aware sampling.
Use validation metrics to select models and inference settings; do not repeatedly tune against the test set.
